name: sops
description: Installs the sops secret editor as a single static binary, verified against its published checksums.

version.description: Channel (latest) or an exact sops version (major.minor.patch).

stateDir.description: Points SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE at <stateDir>/keys.txt (mount a volume to persist the age key across rebuilds). Empty leaves SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE unset.
